project_type: Python FastAPI async web application - Enterprise Document Management System
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), httpx AsyncClient for API tests, SQLite in-memory DBs per test
verification_instructions: Run pytest. All existing 743+ tests must pass plus new tests.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. Python 3.11.14. pytesseract installed but no tesseract binary for OCR tests (mock it). No actual LLM API key (mock LLM calls in tests).
contribution_requirements: All code follows existing patterns. Models inherit Base from app.models.group. APIs registered in app/api/router.py. Services are classes with async methods. Schemas use Pydantic BaseModel.
key_patterns: Models use SQLAlchemy 2.0 mapped_column style. Tests use pytest_asyncio fixtures with db_session/client from conftest.py or create their own. Auth via get_current_user dependency. LLM calls through app/core/llm.py with prompt guard sanitization. Middleware extends BaseHTTPMiddleware from starlette.
directory_structure: app/ - main application (api/, core/, middleware/, models/, schemas/, services/, templates/). tests/ - all test files. storage/ - file storage root.
